themes.title: Communication-Efficient Federated Learning
themes.summary: I study how devices can train a shared model while exchanging less information.
paragraphs: I study how to train a shared machine learning model when data are spread across many devices. Exchanging information between devices can be slow and costly, so my work explores ways to let them do more work locally and communicate less. I develop and analyze methods that account for differences in their data and for devices that cannot always participate.

papers.note: Uses local gradient steps to accelerate communication in federated optimization.
Extends accelerated local training to support client sampling.
Studies compressed gradient differences in methods based on random reshuffling.
Studies how variance reduction can lower total training cost when local computation is expensive.

themes.title: Privacy and Robustness
themes.summary: I develop methods that protect sensitive training data and handle faulty or malicious participants.
paragraphs: My research focuses on protecting sensitive data and making training less vulnerable to faulty or malicious participants. I develop methods that limit the information a model reveals about individuals and reduce the impact of incorrect or deliberately misleading information. I also study how these protections affect the learning process.

papers.note: Combines Byzantine robustness with partial client participation through gradient-difference clipping.
Provides privacy and convergence guarantees while supporting local updates and partial participation.
Studies Byzantine robustness and differential privacy together under weaker assumptions.
Examines differentially private training with orthogonalized optimizer updates.

themes.title: Optimization for Deep Learning
themes.summary: I study the algorithms used to train neural networks and how to improve their speed and memory use.
paragraphs: I study how the choice of training algorithm affects the way neural networks learn. My work combines the design of new methods with mathematical analysis of their behavior. I focus on understanding how quickly they improve a model and how much memory and computation they need.

papers.note: Reduces adaptive-optimizer memory overhead through compression and error feedback.
Develops a convergence framework for randomized low-rank adaptation.
Analyzes training formulations that sparsify both models and gradients.
Studies adaptive step scaling for Muon and related normalized optimizers.
